title: Balatro Basics 4: Mental math, hand calculation, Joker valuation
description:
Balatro Basics Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdNGt-ihEAcEY9VVwmqT4V80xWG9ZWA14 
Balatro Everyday Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q4PPUfrs8jI&list=PLdNGt-ihEAcHeBy6CpppXck5i6PmZ-cau

I try my best to explain some of the quick (and very dirty) mental math I do to figure out how much my hands will be worth. Also, how to judge which of your Jokers is the strongest and which is the weakest. 


(Version 1.0.0n)
